title: Трёхчастные фразовые глаголы: put up with, get away with, come up with

why: Трёхчастные фразовые глаголы (глагол + наречие + предлог) очень часты в живой речи и рабочей переписке: «мириться с», «придумать», «уйти от наказания». Их значение нельзя угадать по отдельным словам, поэтому их учат как единое целое.
formation: глагол + частица + предлог + объект: put up with the noise, come up with an idea.
• Эти глаголы НЕРАЗДЕЛИМЫ: объект всегда стоит в конце, даже местоимение: I put up with it (не ✗ I put it up with).
• Глагол меняется по временам как обычно: puts up with, put up with, putting up with.
• Последнее слово — предлог, поэтому после него идёт существительное или герундий: look forward to meeting you.
• В вопросах предлог остаётся в конце: What are you looking forward to? Who came up with this idea?
usage: 1. Терпеть, мириться: I can't put up with this noise. (Я не могу мириться с этим шумом.)
2. Придумать: Who came up with this name? (Кто придумал это название?) She came up with an excuse. (Она придумала отговорку.)
3. Избежать наказания: He got away with it. (Ему это сошло с рук.)
4. Закончиться, иссякнуть: We've run out of coffee. (У нас закончился кофе.)
5. С нетерпением ждать: I'm looking forward to the weekend. (Жду выходных с нетерпением.)
6. Не отставать, нагонять: I can't keep up with new technologies. We'll catch up with the others next week. (Я не успеваю за новыми технологиями. Мы нагоним остальных на следующей неделе.)
7. Сокращать: We need to cut down on spending. (Нам нужно сократить расходы.)
8. Уважать, защищать, компенсировать: I look up to my mentor. She stood up for her colleague. I'll make up for it. (Я равняюсь на наставника. Она заступилась за коллегу. Я это исправлю.)
signalWords: У всех этих глаголов последнее слово — with, to, of, on, for, up to: put up WITH, look forward TO, run out OF, cut down ON, stand up FOR.
mistakes: ✗ I can't put up this noise → ✓ I can't put up with this noise (предлог with нельзя пропускать).
✗ I put it up with → ✓ I put up with it (трёхчастные глаголы неразделимы).
✗ I'm looking forward to see you → ✓ I'm looking forward to seeing you (to здесь предлог, после него -ing).
✗ We ran out the milk → ✓ We ran out of the milk (нужен of).
✗ What are you looking forward? → ✓ What are you looking forward to? (предлог остаётся в конце вопроса).
remember: Часть 1 + часть 2 + предлог, всё вместе: объект ставим только в конце (put up with IT), после to-предлога идёт -ing.

items.prompt: I can't put ___ with this noise any longer.
items.answer: up

items.prompt: She came ___ with a great idea for the app.
items.answer: up

items.prompt: We've run ___ of coffee.
items.answer: out

items.prompt: I'm really looking forward ___ seeing you.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: He got away ___ cheating on the test.
items.answer: with

items.prompt: Slow down! I can't keep up ___ you.
items.answer: with

items.prompt: It's time to cut down ___ sugar.
items.answer: on

items.prompt: She looks up ___ her older brother.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: We need to (a) come up with (b) get on with a better plan.
items.answer: (a) come up with

items.prompt: He's looking forward (a) to see (b) to seeing his family.
items.answer: (b) to seeing

items.prompt: I'll (a) catch up with (b) get away with you later; start without me.
items.answer: (a) catch up with

items.prompt: Nobody (a) gets away with (b) makes up for breaking the rules in this company.
items.answer: (a) gets away with

items.prompt: Please (a) get on with (b) look out for your work; the deadline is tomorrow.
items.answer: (a) get on with

items.prompt: I'll buy you dinner to (a) make up for (b) run out of missing your birthday.
items.answer: (a) make up for

items.prompt: We must (a) face up to (b) walk out on the problem; we can't ignore it any longer.
items.answer: (a) face up to

items.prompt: Be careful! (a) Look out for (b) Look up to pickpockets in the metro.
items.answer: (a) Look out for

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя фразовый глагол в скобках

items.prompt: I can't tolerate his behavior. (put up with)
items.answer: I can't put up with his behavior.

items.prompt: She invented an excuse. (come up with)
items.answer: She came up with an excuse.

items.prompt: We have no more paper. (run out of)
items.answer: We have run out of paper. / We've run out of paper.

items.prompt: He wasn't punished for the mistake. (get away with)
items.answer: He got away with the mistake.

items.prompt: I admire my mentor. (look up to)
items.answer: I look up to my mentor.

items.prompt: We should reduce our spending. (cut down on)
items.answer: We should cut down on our spending.

items.prompt: She defended her colleague at the meeting. (stand up for)
items.answer: She stood up for her colleague at the meeting.

items.prompt: I eagerly anticipate the holiday. (look forward to)
items.answer: I'm looking forward to the holiday. / I look forward to the holiday.

exercises.instruction: Замените слова местоимением, сделайте отрицание или вопрос

items.prompt: Replace the noun with a pronoun: I put up with the noise.
items.answer: I put up with it.

items.prompt: Replace the noun with a pronoun: We came up with the plan yesterday.
items.answer: We came up with it yesterday.

items.prompt: Replace the noun with a pronoun: They ran out of the milk.
items.answer: They ran out of it.

items.prompt: Replace the noun with a pronoun: She is looking forward to the trip.
items.answer: She is looking forward to it.

items.prompt: Replace the noun with a pronoun: I can't keep up with the new colleagues.
items.answer: I can't keep up with them.

items.prompt: Make it negative (past): They put up with the delays.
items.answer: They didn't put up with the delays.

items.prompt: Ask a question about 'the weekend': You are looking forward to the weekend.
items.answer: What are you looking forward to?

items.prompt: Make a question with Who: Tom came up with this idea.
items.answer: Who came up with this idea?

items.prompt: Я не могу мириться с этим багом.
items.answer: I can't put up with this bug.

items.prompt: Кто придумал это название?
items.answer: Who came up with this name?

items.prompt: У нас закончился кофе.
items.answer: We've run out of coffee. / We have run out of coffee.

items.prompt: Я с нетерпением жду встречи с командой.
items.answer: I'm looking forward to meeting the team.

items.prompt: Ему всё сошло с рук.
items.answer: He got away with it.

items.prompt: Я не успеваю за новыми технологиями.
items.answer: I can't keep up with new technologies. / I can't keep up with the new technology.

items.prompt: Врач сказал мне есть меньше сладкого.
items.answer: The doctor told me to cut down on sweets. / The doctor told me to cut down on sugar.

items.prompt: Мы нагоним остальных на следующей неделе.
items.answer: We'll catch up with the others next week.
